post.summary: Read scoped OpenRouter usage from explicit ephemeral credentials; no account or proxy mutations

202.description: Poll the operation; result.report contains usage and failures

post.description: Register an existing ClinePass custom-provider reference on macOS, or the node standard Amp native source on macOS/Linux. Stores references only; never refreshes or writes source credentials. Requires management mode and Idempotency-Key.

metric_id.description: Stable backend metric identifier when supplied; clients use it instead of interpreting the label.

note.description: Source-provided display details, such as a bonus grant message.

origin.description: Assigned by the backend from the credential creation path; cannot be changed with an account patch.

account_storage_platforms.description: Supported saved-account storage platforms. Linux requires a separately supplied vault master key.

Operation.description: At most 128 operations run concurrently. The latest 128 completed refresh results expire after 15 minutes. Account write results and idempotency keys persist until restart, limited to 4096 distinct keys; new keys beyond that limit return 503 idempotency_full. Existing keys remain replayable.

enabled.description: Enable or disable quota collection for an account without changing its provider login or source configuration.

notifications.description: Ignored legacy notification preferences retained for compatibility with unreleased native builds.

field_path.description: JSON request field location, e.g. region or settings.project_id

kind.description: Read-only reference to a selected standard Codex auth.json. No proxy directory discovery, credential refresh or native writes.

location.description: default selects ~/.codex/auth.json; config selects ~/.config/codex/auth.json; codex_home selects $CODEX_HOME/auth.json. The server pins the selected absolute path.

kind.description: Read-only reference to one explicit entry in ~/.grok/auth.json. The server selects the fixed native path. Credentials stay in the native file and are never refreshed or written by Quotio.

GrokOwnedInput.description: Explicit intake of separately owned Grok CLI OAuth tokens for the default Grok client. Does not read or migrate native credentials or start OAuth. Tokens are stored before any refresh. An interrupted or failed refresh is fenced until this account is removed and separately owned credentials are supplied again.

available_count.description: Provider available_count, not the filtered record count.

credits.description: Available, unexpired credits; absent expiry is retained. Expiring records sort first. Read-only inventory, never consumes a credit.

id.description: Domain-separated SHA-256; never the provider credit ID.

daily_usage.description: Latest 371 supplied daily buckets, sorted ascending. Calendar-date keys are retained for native Today/Yesterday lookup in the presentation timezone. Zero remains known zero.

latest_30_buckets_tokens.description: Sum of the latest 30 supplied buckets, not the last 30 calendar days. Zero is rendered as No data by the existing Swift analytics view.

x-quotio-parent-pipe.description: Inherited stdin token line and lifetime pipe; one stdout JSON record after bind. Authenticate /v1/status before use.
